subject: Architectural deep-dive: Alliant solution lab — scheduling & prework
messages:
From: Alice Chan <alice.chan@AlliantCloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Harmon <mike.harmon@AlliantCloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Alliant x Redwood — Solution Lab (architecture deep-dive)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the Alliant engineering team is excited to take the next step. Wed like to schedule a 90-minute architectural deep-dive / solution lab to align integration points and validate the proposed network/topology for the marketplace deployment.

Proposed goals:
- Walk through Alliant connector flow and the data path from tenant requests to Redwood inference nodes
- Validate network/firewall requirements and VPC peering options
- Confirm auth model and key provisioning (KMS/HSM) for private deployments
- Identify data residency concerns for enterprise customers

Open slots on our side (PST):
- Tue Nov 24, 10:00-11:30
- Thu Nov 26, 13:00-14:30
- Fri Nov 27, 09:00-10:30

Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend (solutions architect + partner manager ideally)? Also, do you have a template agenda we can review? I can send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Cheers,
Alice
Alice Chan
Partner Lead, Alliant Cloud
alice.chan@AlliantCloud.com

--
Alliant Cloud | https://www.alliantcloud.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chan <alice.chan@AlliantCloud.com>
Cc: Mike Harmon <mike.harmon@AlliantCloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Alliant x Redwood — Solution Lab (architecture deep-dive)

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the clear goals. Marcus (solutions architect) and Vanessa (partner manager) will join from our side. We can do Thu Nov 26 13:00-14:30 PST — that matches Marcus's calendar best. If you prefer earlier, we could do Tue Nov 24 at 10:00 but that is a tighter window for our infra team.

I attached a short agenda draft (agenda-draft-v1.pdf) and a proposed prework checklist. Quick notes on attendees and expectations:
- Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai) — system architecture, network/topology, quantization/latency constraints
- Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai) — partnership handoffs, marketplace packaging and go-to-market considerations
- Please have a representative who owns Alliant's network config and another who can speak to tenant onboarding.

Prework request (short):
1) Sample topology diagram (VPN/peering, subnets, NAT, SGs)
2) Any existing firewall rules or egress proxies that will affect persistent connections
3) A list of expected QPS + typical request size so we can model batching and caching

I'll draft a calendar invite once we confirm. If you can confirm Thu 11/26 13:00, well lock it.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: agenda-draft-v1.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Alice Chan <alice.chan@AlliantCloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Mike Harmon <mike.harmon@AlliantCloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Alliant x Redwood — Solution Lab (architecture deep-dive)

Adding a couple of technical asks so we can prepare meaningful artifacts during the session. Ill be in the meeting to walk through our runtime and where integration points will be.

Could you send before the session:
- A sample JSON trace of a typical inference request from Alliant marketplace (headers + payload)
- Certificate/key rotation policy you expect for KMS-backed keys
- Whether Alliant tenants will use mutual TLS or token-based auth when invoking Redwood endpoints

Also, if you have any preference for demonstration scope, we can bring a small sandbox model and run a 10-minute live trace of an inference call so everyone can see latency and KV-cache behavior.

I attached a quick redwood-network-checklist.pdf to help the Alliant infra team map their topology to our requirements.

-on Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-network-checklist.pdf

Well get the sample JSON trace and cert rotation doc to you by EOD Mon 11/30 if we pick the Monday slot; if Wed 12/02 works better we can have those items to you by Tue 12/01.

Proposed new calendar options: 
- Mon Nov 30, 09:30-11:00 PST (preferred) — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Again, apologies for the reschedule. We want the key Alliant infra folks available for the topology discussion.

Best,
Alice

Ill post the calendar invite and link to the joint doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/xyz) and punch a HubSpot note under deal ALL-2026-09-77 so we have a single source of truth. If anything changes, flag it in the doc and well re-sync.

Soojin
